lines.en: label sanadorm50:
I knock on Sana’s door and wait for her to answer.
I can hear what sounds like loud gunfire from inside of the room so either Sana is playing a video game or in grave danger right now.
I knock again to confirm that Sana is not involved in a real gunfight.
: One...second...
The gunfire ceases after several seconds and Sana either pauses her game or dies.
I guess I won’t know the real answer until she lets me in.
Which she wouldn’t be able to do if she was dead.
: Okay...you can come in now...
scene black
As it turns out, Sana has either won the gunfight or-
Actually, for the sake of moving things along, I’m going to assume there was no gunfight at all and that it really was just a video game.
Some might say this is a fair assumption considering Sana has been known to waste away her time with those.
However, that doesn’t mean she isn’t secretly hiding an alternate life as a criminal or something along those lines.
In fact, there are countless situations where people will go on killing sprees only to have all of the people who knew them while they weren’t killing people proclaim how normal said killer was.
I could very well be one of those people.
The normal ones, I mean.
I’d never hurt a fly.
scene sanasnotacyclops1
: Um...hey...
It appears that there may have been a gunfight after all, as Sana is nowhere to be found.
: Sorry. I think I have the wrong room.
: Because my hair isn’t covering my eyes?...
: ...Sana?
: Sensei...you’ve seen me like this before...
: Your...fake surprise is getting a little old.
: It’s not fake. I was actually just inner monologuing about how you lost in a gunfight.
scene sanasnotacyclops2
: Gunfight?...
: Oh, you must be talking about the game I was playing.
scene sanasnotacyclops3
: I’m...still not great at games like that...so I was spending the night practicing so...I don’t look really bad the next time I play with Rin...
: Well I’m glad to see that you’re trying to improve yourself in ways beyond just speaking, but I think there might be better areas to improve in than how well you can shoot virtual stuff.
scene sanasnotacyclops4
: Probably. But...I don’t think I’d have as much fun using my free time on things like that...
: Besides, for all you know...you could really like stuff like that too, Sensei.
: What if...you’re secretly really good at shooters and you just...don’t know it yet?
: That’s not even something I’d want to be good at.
: Why not? Don’t you want to impress girls?
: Since when is that a thing girls are impressed by?
: I know I’d be impressed. Rin too.
: And Molly. And probably even Ami and Ayane.
: Though...I don’t think it’s really possible for you to be any cooler in their books than you already are.
: But...what I’m saying is...that it’s nice finding people who are...good at the things you’re interested in...
scene sanasnotacyclops5
: And...also that I could maybe use someone to practice against since...the AI in this game isn’t very good...
: Ahh. So it was all just one big ploy to get me to play with you.
scene sanasnotacyclops6
: Maybe.
: Are you actually winking at me right now?
scene sanasnotacyclops7
: I’ve winked at you before, too...you just weren’t able to see it.
: You know, I’ve been fortunate...or unfortunate based on how you look at things a very fair amount of times over the last...school year-
: But I think that this plot twist might be the most surprising one yet.
: Heheh...yeah...
: It’s kind of hard to believe with how I started out...huh?
: I mean, you’re not that different from how you started out.
: You just talk a little more and have an extra eye now.
scene sanasnotacyclops8
: Just...for tonight...
: I still like my hair better the other way...I just...also know it can be a bit of a handicap for games that require your full attention.
scene sanasnotacyclops9
: But...yeah...
: I’m...definitely not the same person I was when we met all that...
scene sanasnotacyclops10
: ...time ago?
: How...
: How long have we known each other again?...
: Because...the[school] year isn’t even halfway over and...
I pause for a moment to see where this train of thought takes Sana.
Of course, for me, it’s been much longer than just half a[school] year.
Counting the other iterations of myself (Which apparently sucked even more than me for the most part), I’ve likely gone through this hundreds, if not thousands of times.
How interesting would things be if someone like her caught onto what’s happening as well?
That it’s been longer than half a[school] year.
That we’ve crammed three nearly full ones into the space of one and, if things go according to plan, are going to cram many, many more.
I say, as if I actually have a plan.
If I had a plan, I wouldn’t be simply waiting to see where the train stops.
I’d be helping her get on board or...selling her a ticket or...
Doing anything but watching.
Watching and waiting for her to uncover the secrets of the universe while both myself and Maya have no idea what those secrets even are.
I think.
Frankly, she might know and is just deciding against telling me about it.
scene sanasnotacyclops11
: It’s funny how time can slip away from us, isn’t it?
: Yeah. It’s almost like-
scene sanasnotacyclops12
: It’s almost like one minute...you’re doing one thing...and the next minute...you...don’t even remember what that thing was.
How long have we been playing this for?
And, better question, how did Sana manage to convince me to play a video game in the first place?
scene sanasnotacyclops13
: What?
: Are you...upset at me for...killing you so many times?
: Not really.
: I just think I’m feeling the effects of that whole “time slipping away” thing as we speak.
: That tends to happen to me when I play games as well...
: But it’s not like it doesn’t happen in...different ways, too.
: Is this you admitting that you’re finally in love with me?
scene sanasnotacyclops14
: Wh...What?...No...of course not....
: It’s true that we’re...a lot closer now than before, but...it’s not anything like that....
: I know that. I was just messing around.
Damn it.
: Though, it’s hard to ever really recall a time where we’ve been this close before.
scene sanasnotacyclops15
: That’s...closer to what I was getting at...
: When we first met so, so long ago at the beginning of the[school] year, I never would have imagined...sitting on my bed in the dark with you...
: But now...I can do it without even feeling a little uncomfortable...
: You should feel at least slightly uncomfortable, I think.
scene sanasnotacyclops16
: Why is that?
: Because you’re my teacher and I’m your student?
: That’s a very roundabout way of putting it and doesn’t really touch on the dramatic disparity between our ages and sizes.
: Aren’t we friends before that, though?
: Doesn’t that take priority?
I try my best to play whatever game the two of us are playing, but...as expected, I’m not very good.
I am doing much better than I imagined I would with zero experience, though.
And...I’m already somehow familiar with what all of the buttons do.
Kind of like I’m coasting off of muscle memory despite a complete lack of mental memory.
: I guess the whole friendship thing takes priority.
: I mean, it doesn’t really matter to me either way.
: To be completely honest, I don’t really view any of you girls as friends.
scene sanasnotacyclops17
: You...don’t?
: Not really. No.
: Then...what do you view us as?...
: Hm.
: That’s a complicated question.
: I don’t mind if there’s a...complicated answer...
: What about an answer so simple that it just seems complicated?
: I...don’t know...
: I just...really thought we were friends...this whole time...
: I’m going to kill you if you don’t pay attention.
scene sanasnotacyclops18
: What?!
: In the game.
scene sanasnotacyclops19
: O-Oh...yeah...sorry...
: There’s not really any one word I’d use to describe the relationship I have with all of you girls.
: You’re not friends or lovers or family or any other blanket term I can just toss all of you under.
: I treat every one of you differently and wouldn’t feel right simply calling you one thing or another.
: We can be friendly and not be friends. Just like we can be intimate and not be lovers.
: I...don’t really want-
: But at the end of the day, I’m just me and you’re just you. And Ayane is just Ayane and Ami is just Ami.
: Labels are dumb.
: So...am I still allowed to call you my friend?
: Call me whatever you want. I don’t care.
: Just don’t ask me how I see you, because it’s not a question that’s easy for me to answer.
scene sanasnotacyclops20
: That’s fine...
: There are plenty of questions I find hard to answer, after all...and you’ve never pushed me to actually answer any of them...
: That’s because your life is your life and your secrets are your secrets.
: I don’t need to know things you don’t want me to know.
scene sanasnotacyclops21
: But in the event that you ever want to tell me-
: What?
: Sana?
scene sanasnotacyclops22
: It’s been several years since my brother died now.
: But, somehow, it feels a lot longer.
: I keep a lock of his hair in a box on the table behind you.
: My mom has one too.
: She used to smell it before going to bed every night...and then cry into her pillow thinking I couldn’t hear her from down the hall.
: I did.
: I always did.
: And for a long time, that would make me cry too.
: But now, I can barely even open the box anymore because it just reminds me of what actually happened to him.
: You should ask me what happened to him.
: What are you-
: Making my secrets your secrets.
: Telling you the things I want you to know before I change my mind and don’t want you to know them.
: I don’t want to just be Sana to you anymore.
: I want to be your friend.
: Having you just see me as me...isn't enough to make me feel the way I want to feel.
: I don’t really know how you want to feel, but I can’t just ask you what happened when-
scene sanasnotacyclops23
: I'll just tell you, then.
: He was killed.
: Stabbed to death on his way home from a friend’s house one night.
: He was younger than I am now when it happened.
: We never even found out who did it.
: Now...that’s what I think of every time I open the box.
: That time...really does slip away faster than we expect it to...
: But no amount of time can fix certain things once they break beyond recognition.
: So you’re forced to let it slip even more.
scene sanasnotacyclops24
: He used to play games like this, you know. The same way we are now.
: And whenever he got me to play with him, he’d always take it easy on me.
: So...I’ve been taking it easy on you tonight. Trying to set the example he made for me.
: But...
: I’m still going to kill you if you don’t pay attention.
scene sanasnotacyclops25
I do what I do best and ignore it all.
But, in my defense, that’s what anyone would do in this situation.
Isn’t it?
Who picks a time like this to come out and admit something as tragic as that?
I guess it’s possible that she’s been wanting me to ask for a while...
And I guess it’s also possible that she was desperate for me to know this side of her.
Because, as she said, she wants to be seen as something more than just herself.
But to think that none of this would have happened if I’d just given her what she wanted from the start instead of being desperate to hear the sound of my own voice.
She’s crying because of me.
No.
She’s not crying because of me.
She’s crying because she’s subjected herself to a barrage of unhappy memories in exchange for momentary sympathy and a need to be seen.
But I already saw her.
And I’ll continue to see her each and every day.
I just happen to know a little more now.
I know a little more about a thing I didn’t want to know in the first place.
And now I have to adapt.
: Thank you for telling me that.
And I thank her anyway.
Why?
Why must my mouth once again betray the device that directs it?
Why must I act in opposition to myself when all I really want is to remove her clothes and help her forget the only way I know how?
scene black
Everything goes dark.
For you, at least.
I can still see everything.
I just don’t want you to see anymore.
Not until the two of us return to normal.
Not until what is hers is no longer mine.
You sit in silence and kill each other for the next hour!
